title: [master]"El título Importe pendiente resulta ambiguo entre varios campos de la tabla Mov. proveedor." error if you try to Create Payment for some Vendor Ledger Entries filtered by Remaining Amount <> 0 in the Spanish version.
summary: Fixes an ambiguous caption error on the Create Payment page when creating payments for vendor ledger entries filtered by Remaining Amount <> 0, seen in the Spanish version. The page is changed in the W1 and ES layers, and tests are added in several localizations.
key_points: Fixes the 'Importe pendiente' ambiguous caption error when Create Payment runs on entries filtered by Remaining Amount
Create Payment page (1190) simplified in the W1 and ES base app layers
Regression tests added to ERM Suggest Vendor Payment in the W1, CH, CZ, ES and FI layers
